claim: In vertebrates, immune cells are generated from hematopoietic waves occurring at distinct places and times.

claim: The first hematopoietic wave in vertebrates occurs in the yolk sac and generates primitive erythrocytes and macrophages.

claim: Later hematopoietic waves in vertebrates occur at several time points from embryonic to adult stages and produce all the blood lineages of the adult organism.

claim: Immune cells from distinct hematopoietic waves coexist in vertebrates.
